identify: The photo model matched this to bacterial leaf blight of rice.
Bacterial leaf blight is a major rice disease in India.

thresholds.etl: Early to late tillering: BLB 2-3 infected leaves/m2.

cultural: Reduce the nitrogen fertilizer. If needed, apply only a small dose of nitrogen in more split doses.
Use alternate wetting and drying. Do not let the water stand in the field.
